description: Authored synthetic coding-memory corpus; fictional projects and people; no private source data. Query families stay within one split.

documents.title: Atlas service port
documents.body: Atlas production service listens on port 7712. This is the service port, not the metrics port.

documents.title: Atlas metrics endpoint
documents.body: Atlas exports Prometheus metrics on port 9913. Its main service port is configured separately.

documents.title: Boreal service port
documents.body: Boreal production service listens on port 7724. Boreal is a separate project from Atlas.

documents.title: Juniper cache expiry
documents.body: Juniper keeps cached responses for 45 seconds. After that duration it fetches a fresh response.

documents.title: Cedar retry policy
documents.body: Cedar retries a failed download four times, then leaves the item in a visible error queue. It never silently drops the item.

documents.title: Quartz verification command
documents.body: To verify Quartz before release, run quartz-check --strict. The permissive mode does not validate source signatures.

documents.title: Walnut lock failure
documents.body: In Walnut, LockLeaseExpired means the lease heartbeat was lost. Recovery is to renew the lease before retrying the transaction.

documents.title: Larch checkpoint path
documents.body: Larch stores portable checkpoints in state/handoff.json. Temporary build logs live elsewhere.

documents.title: Spruce queue ownership
documents.body: Mira owns the Spruce queue processor. Oren reviews Spruce documentation but does not own the processor.

documents.title: Birch communication preference
documents.body: The Birch project asks for release notes in German. Source-code identifiers remain English.

documents.title: Rowan persistence backend
documents.body: Rowan persists authoritative records in PostgreSQL. Redis is only a disposable cache.

documents.title: Willow import batch size
documents.body: Willow processes 32 documents in each import batch to keep transactions short.

documents.title: Elm connection timeout
documents.body: Elm abandons a connection attempt after 18 seconds. Read timeout and total job timeout are different settings.

documents.title: Pine backup retention
documents.body: Pine retains 14 daily backups locally. Monthly archives are stored separately.

documents.title: Maple current compiler
documents.body: On 2026-08-20 Maple switched its compiler from Amber to Cobalt. Cobalt is the current compiler as of 2026-09-01.

documents.title: Maple old compiler
documents.body: On 2026-07-01 Maple used compiler Amber. This historical record predates the switch on 2026-08-20.

documents.title: Oak temporary maintenance
documents.body: Oak maintenance window ended on 2026-08-31. As of 2026-09-01 the maintenance window is closed.

documents.title: Erle Datenprüfung
documents.body: Das Projekt Erle prüft eingehende Datensätze mit BLAKE3. Fehlerhafte Prüfsummen werden in die Prüfwarteschlange gestellt.

documents.title: Aspen acknowledgement rule
documents.body: Aspen acknowledges a source window only after every accepted fact and its audit record commit together.

documents.title: Sequoia alias
documents.body: The deployment named Bluebird is the Sequoia staging environment. Its release approver is Lena.

documents.title: Hawthorn adapter
documents.body: Hawthorn sends audit events through adapter Kestrel. Adapter ownership is documented separately.

documents.title: Kestrel ownership
documents.body: Noor owns adapter Kestrel. Rowan owns adapter Falcon, which is unrelated.

documents.title: Alder transfer target
documents.body: In session one, Alder chose the object store named Harbor for exports. Its encryption key name was settled in a later session.

documents.title: Harbor export encryption
documents.body: In session two, Harbor exports were assigned the encryption key harbor-export-key.

documents.title: Cedar sibling retry policy
documents.body: The separate Cedar-Lab project retries downloads seven times. This does not change the four-retry policy in Cedar production.
